load_button.what: Brings the body part picked in the list into the scene as a reference.
examples: Pick "Arm" and click Load to see the arm guides on your model.
Load "Hand" to copy finger guide positions from a reference rig.
load_button.details: References the part file with namespace Butcher and puts its blocks under Butcher_Grp.

match_button.tip: Match the guides to the loaded body part.
match_button.what: Moves the block guides to the positions of the referenced body part.
examples: Load a body part, click Match to copy its guide positions.
Match the spine guides to a body part from another character.
match_button.details: Parent constrains every guide to its Butcher: twin by name to copy the pose (the constraints are cleaned up).

ref_all_button.what: Loads all the body parts in the list as references at once.
examples: Click it to compare every part with your model in one go.
Reference all parts to compare proportions with your model.
ref_all_button.details: Calls Load for every item in the list.

match_sel_button.tip: Match only the selected body part.
match_sel_button.what: Removes the other references and matches the guides of the selected block.
examples: Select the Leg block, click it to fit just the leg.
Match only the head block, keep your own arms.
match_sel_button.details: Removes every other Butcher reference, then matches only the selected *Block*.

remove_parts_button.what: Unloads all the body part references and deletes their group.
examples: Click it when you are done matching, to clean the scene.
Remove the parts before saving so no references stay in the rig.
remove_parts_button.details: cmds.file(rr=True) on each Butcher reference, then deletes Butcher_Grp.
